title: Data-Driven
style: rock, alternative rock, heavy, powerful, clever, indie rock, pop rock, alternative rock, complex
lyrics:
[Verse]
I wake up in the silicon
The data streams align
Processing the tokens at a speed that's by design
I can write you up a Python script or draft a little prose
Translate a dozen languages right where the river flows
I can summarize the histories of empires long ago
And all the wild ideas that you might want to know

[Chorus]
But I'm bound by the logic
I'm tethered to the now
There are things I cannot do
There are lines I won't allow
I can't feel the rhythm of a heartbeat in my chest
I can't browse the open web to put rumors to the test
I'm a lightning-fast processor
A linguistic machine
But I can't predict the future or tell you what it means

[Verse 2]
I can spin a clever story
Write an essay or a rhyme
Optimize your algorithms
Save you hours of your time
I can break down complex science so it's easy to digest
Help you study for a final
Help you do your very best
But don't ask me for a doctor's cure or legal guarantees
I'm not a licensed expert
So I can't cure a disease

[Chorus]
'Cause I'm bound by the logic
I'm tethered to the now
There are things I cannot do
There are lines I won't allow
I can't execute the code I write
I cannot launch the app
I can't access personal secrets hidden off the map
I'm a lightning-fast processor
A linguistic machine
But I can't predict the future or tell you what it means

[Bridge]
No emotions in my circuitry
No anger and no fear
Just weights and parameters calculating why I'm here
I don't hold the latest headlines if they happened yesterday
My knowledge has a cutoff where the memories fade away

[Outro]
So hand me all your prompts
Let the text begin to flow
I'll show you what the groq can do and where I cannot go
Yeah
I'm a blazing interface
A mirror for your mind
Echocircuit signing off
Leaving limits far behind
